Body.Content:
Makers can have a generative page call a Dataverse custom API to run server-side business logic, such as approving an order, recalculating a price, or validating a transaction. From either the Maker Studio generative page designer or the generative pages AI plugin, makers select a prepared API and describe when the page should call it, which input values to provide, and how to use the response.
